EQUITY.approach: 12-1 relative-strength breakout on liquid stocks with a quality-minus-junk filter and 200d market-regime gate
EQUITY.edge_mechanism: slow underreaction to earnings/news plus institutional constraint-driven momentum persistence; the quality filter removes junk names that mean-revert violently
EQUITY.test: After-cost Wilson LB(WR) >= 50% and PSR >= 0.95 on trade returns; confirm with SPA on the frozen parameter set
EQUITY.external_benchmark: AQR Momentum Indices + Quality Minus Junk: https://www.aqr.com/Insights/Datasets/Momentum-Indices-Monthly ; https://www.aqr.com/Insights/Research/Working-Paper/Quality-Minus-Junk
EQUITY.kill_rule: Abandon if OOS after-cost PF < 1.3 or Wilson LB < 50% after 200 trades, or if any one strategy/name exceeds 15% of class volume

CRYPTO.approach: Crowding-extreme contrarian on top-20 liquid perpetuals, gated by ATR percentile plus funding/open-interest/sentiment extremes
CRYPTO.edge_mechanism: leveraged crowding and liquidation cascades overshoot fair value; mean reversion works only when positioning and volatility are extreme
CRYPTO.test: After-cost Wilson LB(WR) >= 50% and SPA rejects a zero-edge null on net_edge_bps; verify only on clean post-promotion cohorts
CRYPTO.external_benchmark: Hyperliquid HLP public vault and protocol docs: https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hypercore/vaults/protocol-vaults
CRYPTO.kill_rule: Abandon if after-cost PF < 1.3 or Wilson LB < 50% after 150 trades, if the edge only survives in illiquid small caps, or if any strategy breaches 15% of class volume

FOREX.approach: G10 carry plus 12m trend composite with central-bank regime filter; no exotics and no retail-sentiment copy signals
FOREX.edge_mechanism: rate-differential carry and slow macro-policy repricing persist; the trend leg avoids classic carry blowups
FOREX.test: After-cost DSR > 0 and PSR >= 0.95 on weekly returns, plus Wilson LB(WR) >= 50% on executed trades
FOREX.external_benchmark: AQR Value and Momentum Everywhere currencies + Myfxbook verification standard: https://www.aqr.com/Insights/Datasets/Value-and-Momentum-Everywhere-Factors-Monthly ; https://www.myfxbook.com/help/knowledge-base/verification/
FOREX.kill_rule: Abandon if G10-only OOS PF < 1.1 or DSR <= 0 after 300 trades, or if profitability disappears under conservative spread/slippage assumptions

COMMODITY.approach: CFTC commercial-hedger extreme reversal with term-structure confirmation on liquid commodity futures
COMMODITY.edge_mechanism: commercials have superior physical-market information; hedging-pressure and inventory imbalances create predictable reversals at extremes
COMMODITY.test: After-cost Wilson LB(WR) >= 50% and SPA rejects a zero-edge null on weekly trade returns
COMMODITY.external_benchmark: CFTC COT reports + KMLM managed-futures peer: https://www.cftc.gov/MarketReports/CommitmentsofTraders/AbouttheCOTReports/index.htm ; https://kraneshares.com/kmlm
COMMODITY.kill_rule: Abandon if OOS after-cost PF < 1.3 after 100 trades, or if fewer than 3 contracts explain most of the PnL

ETF.approach: Dual-momentum rotation across broad and sector ETFs with an absolute-trend cash filter
ETF.edge_mechanism: cross-asset relative strength persists because macro flows rebalance slowly; the absolute-trend filter cuts left-tail bear exposure
ETF.test: PSR >= 0.95 on monthly rotation returns and Wilson LB(WR) >= 50% on executed switches
ETF.kill_rule: Abandon if OOS PF < 1.2 or PSR < 0.95 after 60 monthly decisions, or if one ETF sleeve exceeds 15% of class volume

BOND.approach: Rates-futures time-series momentum with carry/roll-down overlay on liquid sovereign futures only
BOND.edge_mechanism: term-premium and policy-regime changes reprice slowly; carry/roll pays while the macro trend persists
BOND.test: After-cost DSR > 0 and PSR >= 0.95 on weekly/monthly futures returns
BOND.external_benchmark: AQR Value and Momentum Everywhere government bonds + DBMF: https://www.aqr.com/Insights/Datasets/Value-and-Momentum-Everywhere-Factors-Monthly ; https://www.imgp.com/us/fund/us53700t8273-imgp-dbi-managed-futures-strategy-etf/
BOND.kill_rule: If you cannot run liquid rates futures and reach OOS PF > 1.3 on n >= 120, abandon BOND directional trading; the current cash-bond sample is too thin to trust

30d.task: Build a clean forward cohort ledger: every new pick gets promotion_at, rehab_vs_prod flag, strategy, symbol, asset class, cost model, net_edge_bps, and concentration tags
30d.acceptance_gate: 100% of new trades have those fields populated; no more approximate forward cohorts for new promotions

30d.task: Quarantine negative-edge/high-share strategies to rehab only while honoring mutate-before-kill: move `quan_engine`, `unknown`, and all legacy FOREX families out of production allocation
30d.acceptance_gate: No production strategy exceeds 15% class volume; `quan_engine` and `unknown` have 0% production share; top-2 CRYPTO share < 30%

30d.task: Harden price/cost plumbing with resolver-v2 and the required crypto fallback chain Binance(api/api1/api2/api3) -> CoinGecko -> KuCoin -> CryptoCompare
30d.acceptance_gate: 100% of crypto closes log the source path; no close depends on one endpoint; after-cost recompute matches audit totals within 1%

30d.task: Run a FOREX rehab matrix: inverse polarity, DNA mutation, symbol rotation, session filter, G10-only restriction
30d.acceptance_gate: At least 12 rehab variants launched and at least 3 show positive after-cost net_edge_bps on >= 30 OOS paper trades each

60d.task: Rebuild CRYPTO around survivors only, weighted by net_edge_bps times sqrt(n) with hard strategy and symbol caps
60d.acceptance_gate: CRYPTO forward cohort n >= 150, after-cost PF >= 1.35, MDD < 15%, no strategy > 15%, no symbol > 10%

60d.task: Promote at most one FOREX family from rehab if it survives a clean holdout; everything else stays paper-only
60d.acceptance_gate: One G10 family reaches n >= 60, after-cost PF >= 1.1, Wilson LB >= 48%, MDD < 10%; otherwise FOREX remains rehab-only

60d.task: Add an independent holdout review for every promotion using SPA/PSR; no parameter edits after the holdout starts
60d.acceptance_gate: Every promoted family passes SPA or PSR >= 0.95 on data not used for mutation/tuning

90d.task: Decision gate for CRYPTO broad class
90d.acceptance_gate: Clean forward n >= 300, after-cost PF >= 1.5, Wilson LB >= 50%, MDD < 20%, no strategy > 15%; otherwise collapse to a narrow winner-only book
Clean forward n >= 100, after-cost PF >= 1.2, Wilson LB >= 50%, MDD < 10%, and breadth across >= 6 G10 pairs; otherwise abandon FOREX

90d.task: Operationalize a standing rehab board and weekly deallocation rule
90d.acceptance_gate: No production strategy with negative net_edge_bps survives 2 consecutive weekly reviews

risk_register.risk: Forward-cohort contamination from missing promotion logs creates fake edge
risk_register.mitigation: Make promotion timestamps mandatory and invalidate any forward claim without them

risk_register.risk: Concentration risk makes one lucky strategy or symbol look like an asset-class edge
risk_register.mitigation: Hard-cap strategy share at 15% and symbol share at 10%, with automatic deallocation on breach

risk_register.risk: Fees, spreads, and slippage are understated, especially in FOREX and CRYPTO
risk_register.mitigation: Use conservative round-trip cost haircuts and compare paper vs realized slippage weekly

risk_register.risk: Mutation pipeline overfits and manufactures one-off winners
risk_register.mitigation: Preregister each mutation family, cap the mutation budget, and require SPA/PSR on untouched holdouts

risk_register.risk: Resolver or market-data failures distort closes and ranking metrics
risk_register.mitigation: Dual-source reconciliation, logged fallback usage, and automatic quarantine on anomalous closes

do_not_optimize: Do not tune TP/SL before the entry signal has positive after-cost edge
Do not keep the best 5 of 100 random seeds or mutations and call it robustness
Do not mine strategy-symbol pairs until one passes by chance
Do not use the same data for mutation, promotion, and evaluation
Do not trust PF>2 on n<30 or on one dominant symbol
Do not hide losers by raising score thresholds instead of fixing source selection
Do not judge progress on gross PnL; use after-cost net_edge_bps
Do not claim clean forward evidence while promotion logging is missing
q2_rescue_plan.exit_ramp: Abandon FOREX entirely if, after 90 days of clean cohort tracking, no rehabilitated G10-only family reaches n >= 100, after-cost PF >= 1.2, Wilson LB >= 50%, and MDD < 10%, or if the best result depends on 2 or fewer pairs or one session. Continue FOREX rescue only if one family clears those gates with breadth across at least 6 pairs. For CRYPTO, abandon the broad multi-source class and keep only a narrow survivor book if, after removing `quan_engine` and `unknown`, the class still cannot reach n >= 300, PF >= 1.5, MDD < 20%, and <= 15% strategy concentration; continue only with survivor families and keep draggers in rehab.
